ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; do not penalise the rider; note the driver's premature cancellation (waited 3 min 5 s after the "I'm Here" tap, short of the >3-minute requirement) on the driver's record.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's written statement that he 'waited more than 3 minutes' is a claim, and the system timeline (F4, F6) shows cancellation only ~3 min 5 s after the 'I'm Here' tap — the post-tap wait does not clearly exceed 3 minutes, so NS-1(iii) is not established and the fee cannot stand under NS-2.
